narr: An MCS developed across central Virginia on August 17, producing heavy rain and flash flooding as it slowly moved east.
ev: Fredericksburg Turnpike was partially closed due to standing water between Campbell Road and Minarchi Road.
The 911 call center reported water over the roadway at the intersection of King William Road and Footpath Road.
